note: Admin panel ka '🔒 Security' card. who: claude (accounts milne pe Claude karega) | you (aapko khud karna hai — password/2FA kabhi chat me nahi). done:true jab ho jaaye (ya Claude ko bolo). Detail: docs/SECURITY.md

items.task: Gmail, GitHub, Cloudflare, Namecheap — sab pe 2-step verification (authenticator app, SMS nahi)
items.why: Hacker site tak sirf inhi accounts se pahunch sakta hai. 2FA = password chori ho tab bhi andar nahi aa sakta.

items.task: Recovery codes print karke ghar pe safe rakho (phone kho jaaye tab kaam aate hain)
items.why: Bina inke phone khone pe khud ka account lock ho sakta hai.

items.task: Namecheap: Domain Lock ON + auto-renew ON
items.why: Domain chori (transfer) ya bhool se expire hone se bachaav — expire hua to koi aur khareed lega.

items.task: GitHub: repo private + main branch protection (sirf PR se change)
items.why: Koi galti se ya chori ke token se seedha live site badal na sake.

items.task: GitHub: secret scanning + Dependabot alerts ON
items.why: Galti se key commit ho ya kisi package me bug mile to turant email.

items.task: Cloudflare: Always HTTPS, TLS 1.2+, DNSSEC ON
items.why: Beech me data churana / fake DNS se bachaav.

items.task: Cloudflare: Bot Fight Mode ON (Google/Bing jaise achhe bots allowed rehte hain)
items.why: Scraper aur bekaar bots khud ruk jaate hain, users ko kuch nahi dikhta.

items.task: Cloudflare: /go/ affiliate links pe rate limit (bot clicks rokne ke liye)
items.why: Bot ke fake clicks se affiliate account band ho sakta hai (purane AdSense jaisa). Ye sabse zaroori.

items.task: Cloudflare: WAF rule — /wp-admin, /.env, /xmlrpc.php jaise hacker-scan block
items.why: Logs saaf, bekaar load kam. (Hamari site pe ye files hain hi nahi.)

items.task: Cloudflare Access: admin panel sirf aapke email se (OTP)
items.why: Kamai/traffic data koi aur na dekh sake.

items.task: Email: SPF + DMARC record (Email Routing ke saath)
items.why: Koi aapke domain ke naam se fake email na bhej sake.

items.task: Search Console: Manual actions + Security issues har hafte ek nazar
items.why: Google koi problem dekhe to sabse pehle yahin batata hai.
